data.name: Armida
data.gender_notes: Armida is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Armida is derived from the Latin word 'Armi', meaning 'soldier' or 'warrior'. This name was given to a famous sorceress in the medieval epic poem 'Orlando Furioso' by Ludovico Ariosto. Despite being a sorceress and a villain in the story, Armida is known for her powerful and strong-willed character. The name Armida carries the meaning “Powerful, strong willed” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Armida usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong willed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and determination in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Armida belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, strong willed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Armida total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_greek.name: Αρμίδα
